title: The test-author scope guard lets a test-author edit files under testing/
why: Guard test-author-scope's TEST_DIRS lacks testing/, so it refused a test-author edit to a test-only fixture, testing/shallow_clone.py (lane lane-lint-unshallow, PR #1831, head 715490c38, with runner 8; coordinator, 01:58 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: point TEST_DIRS at the constant the code uses for test folders, not a copy (rule building-allow-list-is-the-constant), so testing/ is covered. Red case first: a test-author Write to testing/shallow_clone.py is refused on today's guard; control: a test-author Write to product code stays refused. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7).
